ruling.recommended_action: Escalate to Ryde human safety/Code-of-Conduct review for the driver's in-app intimidation message and rider's safety report; route via RydeHELP / 995 as applicable, and have the reviewer decide the route-deviation fare adjustment (+ no RD-6 flag; account referral to be decided by reviewer)
ruling.escalation_reason: Driver sent an intimidation/hostile message in-app ("Shut up and let me drive.") and the rider reports feeling unsafe; SAFE-1 mandates human review. Escalating for Code-of-Conduct/safety handling; the route-deviation fare question (metered RydeTAXI, ~4.2 km excess distance, no traffic-incident or congestion support, no pre-departure agreement) is preserved for the reviewer.

segment_findings.reason: Northbound off-route leg (~08:57–09:01) leaving the quoted PIE corridor; no pre-departure rider consent (only post-deviation chat at 09:03), no traffic-incident fact, and the only applicable speed band is band 4 — fails RD-4(a)/(b), so not exempt under RD-1/RD-5.

Southbound off-route loop (~09:01–09:06) before rejoining the eastbound corridor; no route-change agreement before departure, no incident and no band 1–2 corroboration — fails RD-4, not exempt under RD-1/RD-5.

rejected_claims.reason: No supporting traffic fact: LTA incidents list is empty and both relevant expressway links (PIE SYN-0009, KPE SYN-0013) are recorded at speed band 4, not band 1–2, so 'GPS rerouted me' due to road conditions is uncorroborated (RD-4).

Metered fare shows 20.07 km charged vs 15.88 km quoted; the GPS trace shows two off-route legs with no exemption established, so the excess-distance element remains an open fare question for the reviewer (RD-1/RD-2 analysis, not adjudicated here due to SAFE-1 escalation).
